patch_description:
Replace the random Gaussian sample with a deterministic multi-start optimizer for the actual scale-invariant diameter-packing objective.  The optimizer maximizes a differentiable soft approximation to the log of the minimum pairwise distance minus the log of the maximum pairwise distance, gradually sharpening that approximation so that the final iterations concentrate on active closest and farthest pairs.

Each restart is centered and RMS-normalized only to remove the objective’s translation and scaling null directions; this does not impose a unit-cube or unit-sphere constraint.  The best candidate is selected using the evaluator’s exact squared distance ratio rather than the smoothed training objective.  Fixed seeds make the returned 14-point configuration reproducible.
